description.pt: Frango desfiado suculento, caldo super cremoso de milho verde fresco, milho inteiro, cheiro-verde e temperos especiais de Minas Gerais. Perfeito para aquecer os dias frios.
description.en: Juicy shredded chicken breast, silky sweet corn chowder, whole corn kernels, fresh scallions, and traditional Minas Gerais seasoning. Perfect for cold island days.

extra.pt: Acompanha cheiro-verde e torradas artesanais quentinhas
extra.en: Includes fresh herbs and warm artisanal toast

name.en: Creamy Yucca & Bacon Soup (Caldo de Mandioca)

description.pt: Mandioca selecionada extremamente aveludada, cozida lentamente com temperos caseiros, refogado de alho, cebola, bacon e cheiro-verde. Sabor marcante e inesquecível!
description.en: Smooth, velvety cassava/yucca root slowly simmered with sautéed garlic, sweet onions, crispy bacon bits, and fresh herbs. Rich, hearty, and deeply satisfying!

extra.en: Includes crispy bacon / fresh herbs and toast
